description: This file defines the EventScheduler class, which manages schedulable events in a timestamped buffer. It provides methods to add, retrieve, and wait for events based on their timestamps, supporting thread-safe operations and event pooling for reuse.

classes.name: EventScheduler
classes.description: Manages a timestamped buffer of schedulable events, allowing thread-safe addition and retrieval based on event timestamps.

classes.name: EventScheduler.SchedulableEvent
classes.description: Base class for events that can be scheduled in the EventScheduler, encapsulating a timestamp and linked list pointers.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds an event to the scheduler, inserting into the appropriate timestamped list.

methods.name: getNextEvent
methods.description: Checks if any scheduled events are ready to be processed at or before the provided time.

methods.name: waitNextEvent
methods.description: Waits until the next event is ready to be processed, blocking if necessary.

methods.name: addEventToPool
methods.description: Recycles an event for future reuse by adding it to the event pool.

methods.name: removeEventfromPool
methods.description: Retrieves an event from the pool for reuse, maintaining at least one event in the pool.
